rationale: The replication reproduces the inverse MCE sign, the field-robust magnetization jump (the defining In-alloy feature), Tm~296K, and ΔS_mag~14 J/kg/K matching the paper's Fig.4 (~12-14). However, ΔT_ad overshoots by ~1.8x (-10.8 vs -6 K), RCP differs by ~2x, and critically the routed kernel (skyrmion orbital Hall) was inapplicable—the entire BEG+Potts MC was built from scratch rather than using the paper's KKR-CPA ab initio exchange constants. The two-branch surrogate avoids the actual first-order nucleation dynamics and cannot reproduce hysteresis. Key qualitative physics replicated but quantitative headline and methodological fidelity gaps warrant PARTIAL.
